text:
olivia: FYI we're seeing a shortfall in south-asia (asia-south1) A100 capacity for the weekend demo fleet. Need quick fallback plan. Anyone with quota / vendor contacts?

kevin: How big is the shortfall? numbers?

olivia: ~12 GPUs for Sat-Sun (2x 6 GPU jobs). Current reserved buffer 4. We can't reschedule. Need either borrow from eu-west or vendor burst.

sam: pinging GCP quota team now. @vendor-bot can you check partner pool availability for `asia-south1`?

vendor-bot: Partner pool check triggered. Response ETA ~15m.

tara: If vendor can't cover, we have two options: (1) swap demo to eu-west2 (latency ok for demos?) or (2) use preemptible spot blend + lower batch size. Which is acceptable?

olivia: Latency to eu-west2 is borderline but demos run UI-only so ok. Prefer vendor first. Need a quick runbook for cross-region swap though.

kevin: +1 to vendor first. If migrate, we need DNS sticky ip + console routing. I'll drop a quick checklist.

kevin: ```Checklist:
- create eu-west2 pool (6x A100)
- update routing in console: /routes/demos
- grant tenant access
- run smoke canary: echo 'ok' > /tmp/canary```

sam: GCP replied: quota request queued, no guaranteed approval before Friday EOD. Vendor bot still pending.

vendor-bot: Partner pool results: vendor-X has 8 A100 available in asia-south1, vendor-Y has 0. Contact: asia-support@vendor-x.ai, phone +65 9123 4567.

olivia: Nice. Can someone confirm procurement ok to book 8 temporarily? We still need 4 more.

nishi: I can reallocate 2 GPUs from internal test pool (west coast) -> we still need 2. Also I can open a short-term spot request to borrow 2 GPUs from partner marketplace.

tara: Could we compress jobs? If we reduce batch size by ~20% we free 2 GPUs maybe.

olivia: Ok plan: 8 vendor-X + 2 internal reallocate + batch compress to free 2 = 12. Action items: nishi to reallocate, kevin to initiate vendor contact and create temporary booking, sam to follow quota in case we need region failover, tara to prepare cross-region routing doc in case. I'll take follow-up with Support to log procurement ticket.

kevin: I'll email asia-support@vendor-x.ai now with template: ```Subject: Short-term A100 burst request (asia-south1) - 8 GPUs - dates: 2026-03-21 to 2026-03-23 - contact: kevin@redwood.ai - billing: cc finance@redwood.ai```

sam: noted. tagging @oncall in case something pops during weekend.

oncall: rolling coverage ping acknowledged. set alert if pool utilization > 85%.

olivia: thanks all. I'll update thread when vendor confirms. :thumbsup: 

kevin: vendor replied with provisional hold until payment verification. sending invoice to finance.

nishi: reallocation done, moved 2 GPUs from west coast test pool to asia-south1 soft-claim. Job scheduler shows capacity now 10/12.

olivia: Great. Leaving thread open until vendor invoice settled. Last call: any objections to moving forward?

tara: no objections.

sam: no objections.

kevin: none. proceeding.

olivia: vendor confirmed; booking complete. Closing thread.
